title: ortholoma heterophyllum
intro: Ortholoma heterophyllum, commonly known as  Gokshura or Tribulus, is a plant species native to the Indian subcontinent and parts of Asia. It has been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, including its ability to support kidney and liver function, as well as its potential to lower blood pressure and cholesterol levels. The therapeutic actions of Ortholoma heterophyllum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are believed to possess anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory properties. Additionally, the plant has been found to exhibit anti-diabetic, anti-cancer, and anti-aging properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
